title: Groundwater Interface Mass Ledger Prepared Publication Remediation
trigger: F-GC21 atomicity review found that F-GC19 commit_trial still performs floating-point accumulation and integer increment at publication time. A recoverable or arithmetic failure after coupled physical publication would make accounting asymmetric.
objective: Move every recoverable ledger publication check before coupled physical publication. Add a reversible prepared ledger reservation whose final commit is deterministic assignment only and has no recoverable normal-runtime rejection path.
required_semantics: prepare_trial preflights finite accumulation before performing the sum
prepare_trial reserves a unique bounded generation and consumes the active trial
prepared state blocks new staging until commit or abort
prepare mutates no committed mass total or committed exchange count
abort_prepared changes no committed mass total or committed exchange count
commit_prepared performs assignment of precomputed values only and exposes no recoverable status result
old commit_trial is implemented as prepare plus deterministic prepared commit
groundwater cumulative amount remains the exact arithmetic negative of the one canonical SWAP cumulative amount
no external-model, file-format, calendar or timestep assumption
qualification: prepare then abort leaves committed ledger unchanged
prepare then commit publishes exactly once
new staging is blocked while a reservation is prepared
overflow-prone real accumulation is rejected before floating-point addition and without FPE
counter/generation increments are guarded before arithmetic
hard_nonclaims: no physical SWAP or groundwater commit
